'''Thel Erelen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] diplomat during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], he organized a meeting with [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] executives, including [[Serrol Gathip]], at the [[Duro Delta Twelve]], only to have it crashed by [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|COMPNOR]] agent [[Sedret Fain]].
